 Actor Sai Durgha Tej and Kiran got engaged at Hilton Hyderabad Genome Valley Resort on THURSDAY (5th November 2026).
 The couple got engaged in the presence of their families and loved ones.
 The ceremony was a cherished family occasion, bringing together members of the Konidela and Allu families, along with close relatives and friends, to celebrate the couple as they embark on a new chapter in their lives.
 The wedding of Sai Durgha Tej and Kiran is scheduled to take place on December 10, 2026, in Hyderabad.
 The engagement was attended by Sai Durgha Tej’s parents, Dr. Siva Prasad and Vijaya Durga, and his brother Vaishnav Tej, along with Chiranjeevi and Surekha Konidela; Ram Charan; Allu Arjun and Sneha Reddy; Allu Bobby and Neela Shah; Varun Tej, Lavanya Tripathi and Vaayuv Tej; Naga Babu and Padmaja; Niharika Konidela; Allu Aravind and Allu Nirmala; Allu Sirish and Nayanika Reddy; and Akira Nandan and Aadhya.
 Close friends and colleagues, including Manchu Manoj and Bhuma Mounika Reddy; Naveen Vijay Krishna; Harsha Chemudu; Venky Kudumula; Navdeep; and Harshith Reddy, were also present.
